fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: Leader of the Freedom Front Plus (Vryheidsfront Plus)
rows.text: The release dated 2016-11-12 says "Dr. Pieter Mulder, VF Plus-leier, het homself nie weer as leier verkiesbaar gestel" at the party's triennial elective congress taking place that weekend in Johannesburg.

rows.role_title: Leader of the Freedom Front Plus (Vryheidsfront Plus)
rows.text: The same release says he did not stand again at the party's "driejaarlikse verkiesingskongres wat hierdie naweek in Johannesburg plaasvind" (triennial elective congress taking place this weekend in Johannesburg), and that the meeting would now have to designate a new leader.

rows.role_title: Leader of the Freedom Front Plus (Vryheidsfront Plus)
rows.text: The release says "Dr. Mulder is vanjaar 15 jaar lank leier van die VF plus nadat hy in 2001 onbestrede as leier gekies is na genl. Constand Viljoen se uittrede" (he has led the party for 15 years, after being chosen unopposed in 2001 following Gen. Constand Viljoen's retirement).

bounded_scope: Freedom Front and Freedom Front Plus leader observations for CLAUDE-C01-30 only (role za_ff_leader on the VRYHEIDSFRONT PLUS observation).
